messages:
Jordan: Thanks everyone for the loud turnout in today's all-hands Q&A on the outage. Dropping follow-ups & owners here so nothing slips.
Priya: Two asks from the meeting: where's the RCA link and who takes immediate mitigation?
Sam: RCA (draft) attached: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-03-22-draft. Summary: cache invalidation race + router retry storm. I'll be updating with traces.
Anika: I'll lead the short-term mitigation: hot-key rate-limits + fix in router retry logic. Plan: patch by Thu EOD, canary Fri AM, full rollout Mon.
Marcus: For customer-facing SLAs, we should prioritize Dedicated & Private tenants first. Jordan can you confirm?
Jordan: Confirmed. Dedicated/Private customers get priority on mitigations and comms. I'll draft the exec note after Priya's SLO sync.
Priya: I'll run a 30m SLO sync (eng-sre, platform, product) Wednesday 10am. Goal: recommend whether to tighten latency SLOs (95->99) or keep and add compensating controls.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03122 status updated to "monitoring" by Sam. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03122
Sam: Adding two artifacts to the RCA: problematic query & aggregated error rate graph. Debug snippet we used: ```promql
increase(http_request_errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[10m])
```
Anika: Canary run checklist I'll post in #eng-runtime tonight. Note: the patch exposed a flaky integration test; isolating it now to avoid rollout noise.
Marcus: Can someone add a dashboard tile for hot-key retry spikes? I can build it if eng-telemetry signs off.
Eva: I'll help with customer comms templates and pre-approve the Dedicated/Private messaging. Jordan, ping me when the exec blurb is ready.
Sam: Will mark RCA owners and expected close date (target: close by next Tue) once Anika confirms successful canary.
Priya: Invites sent for the SLO sync. Agenda attached: incident recap, telemetry slices needed, tradeoff table, recommendation template.
Jordan: Great work. If anyone else needs to be looped in as an owner, reply here. We want to close action items within the sprint. :thumbsup:
